name: How does Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution handle privacy for high-profile luxury condo sales?

mainEntity.name: How does Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution handle privacy for high-profile luxury condo sales?

acceptedAnswer.text: We understand the importance of discretion for high-profile luxury condo sales. Our approach includes confidential marketing strategies, private showings, and targeted outreach to pre-qualified buyers. We can implement off-market or 'pocket' listings to limit public exposure while still reaching the appropriate buyer pool. In sensitive transactions, especially for properties on Fisher Island or in celebrity-favored areas, we prioritize safeguarding client privacy throughout the entire sales process, ensuring confidentiality agreements are in place as needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: We manage high-profile luxury condo sales with confidential strategies, private showings, targeted outreach, and off-market listings, prioritizing client privacy and discretion.
